findings.finding: README-v11's 'Replay scope' says R10 replays the contract's own vectors, 'which need nothing beyond the three contract files and the frozen I06 inputs R10 already embeds'. That sentence comes from README-v10, where it held. README section 11 likewise says HE-004-I01B4 'replays this contract's vectors'. In v2 that replay is check_vectors, which does need more: it reads profile v2's schema through _profile_schema (PROFILE_SCHEMA, file sha256 e5ef3c3d…d592), and _check_complete runs proxy_profile_v2.validate(profile, schema) and proxy_profile_v2.precondition(profile, namespace) (8 checks; 323 in all). No registered file holds the schema or its pin: definitions.json frozenInputs lists only the three I06 inputs, and v11 notes[3] lists profile.schema.json as not registered. notes[3] gives only the models' reason for that. It drops v10's reason for leaving PPS out ('the replay reads only PPV's positive, never the profile schema'), which no longer holds for v2's own vectors. So the contract text states an R10 replay that the registered files cannot support, or leaves undefined which of the complete positive's eight checks R10 replays.
findings.requiredChange: As the lane monitor rules on Q-C1-1. Recommended form: state the R10 replay scope exactly in README-v11 ('Replay scope' and 'Not registered'), in edge v11 notes[3] and in README section 11. R10 replays every helper vector and every vector. Of the complete positive it replays v1's five checks and the sealed-namespace equality. Profile v2's validate and precondition on the complete positive are harness-side checks of the fixture (the v2 model's replay and the v2 layer test), as validate_profile with PPS was under v1. So R10 needs neither profile.schema.json nor proxy_profile_v2, and profile.schema.json stays unregistered for that stated reason. Alternative form, if the monitor rules that HE-004-I01B4 must validate the complete positive under profile v2: register profile.schema.json in v11, and state in README section 11 that R10 ports profile v2's validator (P00-P35) and replays profile v2's vectors, because the schema alone covers P00 only. In either form the README's bytes change, so edge v11's README row follows (a candidate c2).

questions: Q-C1-1 (my view; the monitor rules): the seven new rows are complete for W2 and for W3 as profile v2's status.json defines them. W2 is 'edge v11 (S2) also registers profile v2's vectors.json for R10, beside the v4 files'. W3 is R10's re-vendor replaying 'the wire vectors' binding and observation cases with profile v2's positive', and that positive is inside the registered vectors.json. HE-004-I01B4 need not validate the complete positive with profile v2's schema. The observer derives and compares projections and digests and never validates a profile. VPO's validate_messages, the wire check R10 mirrors, reads no profile schema. And v1 is the precedent: edge v10 registered PPV but not PPS ('the replay reads only PPV's positive, never the profile schema'), while validate_profile on the complete positive was the layer test's (C1-1). Registering profile.schema.json alone would not let R10 run proxy_profile_v2.validate: the schema covers only P00, P01-P35 live in the model, v11 copies no model, and definitions.json carries no schema pin. Recommendation: do not register the schema; state the replay scope instead (finding C1-1). If the monitor wants R10 to validate the complete positive under profile v2, that widens S3/W3 (a port of profile v2's validator and a replay of its vectors). Then v11 should register profile.schema.json, and README section 11 should say so.

Q-C1-2 (my view; the monitor rules): the line is right for an in-tree round 1 and should stay. It follows LPK-1's form: profile v2's README carries its candidate line ('the candidate line the README is reviewed with; status.json governs'), and the v2 status.json says the same in readmeStatusNote, with contractState CANDIDATE and candidateState 'c1 … not adopted'. Recommendation: keep it. If this round leads to a c2, the line names c2, and edge v11's README row follows the new sha256. At adoption the line stays as reviewed, and status.json governs.
